description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing ShareEntity objects within a Room database, including methods for inserting and querying share records.

classes.name: ShareDao
classes.description: DAO interface for ShareEntity with methods to add and retrieve share records.

methods.name: addShareEntities
methods.description: Inserts a list of ShareEntity objects into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: getShareEntities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ShareEntity objects from the database filtered by the specified path.
